# UniversalComputationAtCriticality

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The property of critical dynamical systems to implement arbitrary logical or algorithmic operations through their state transitions, without explicit programmability. Suggests that topology-driven critical states can serve as reconfigurable, universal computational fabrics for TCC architectures.
